en: Dependent on a non-mental state, a non-mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-mental state, a non-non-mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-mental state, both a non-mental state and a non-non-mental state arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-mental state, a non-mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-mental state, a mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-mental state, both a mental and a non-mental state arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither mental nor non-mental, a non-mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither mental nor non-mental, a non-mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither mental nor non-mental, states that are both mental and non-mental arise.
They arise by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*).

There are nine [ways] under the root condition …pe… five under the prenascence (*purejāta*) and repetition (*āsevana*) conditions …pe… nine under the non-disappearance (*avigata*) condition. (The full detail is given in all cases.)
